skipped.reason: Page is a newspaper clipping ('Olsenmen Record Initial Big 10 Win After Two Losses' by Bob Dunn) for the Jan 15, 1938 Ohio State vs Iowa game (Ohio State won 48-29, Coliseum, Coach Olsen, Captain McDonald). A box score table is present but printed in very small/degraded newsprint type; individual G./F./MF./PF./Pts. column digits for player rows (Baker, Hull, Sattler, McDonald, Boughner, Stafford, Edward, Schick, Goletz, Lynch, Prewitt for Ohio State; Stephens, Johnson, Dreas, Kinnick, Van Voedigk, Praise, Lind, and several more for Iowa) are not legible with confidence. A best-effort transcription attempt produced player-point sums that did not reconcile with the printed team totals (Ohio State sum ~44 vs. listed 48; Iowa sum ~28 vs. listed 29), so the game was dropped per the ruthless-skip-on-checksum-failure rule rather than guessing individual stat values.
